verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains only portal menu labels (file new business, order good-standing certificates, UCC search) and account-usage tips such as password reset, transaction history and paying without registering. None of it is plain-language, step-by-step guidance a non-lawyer founder could follow to complete a filing task. The main sos.state.mn.us site, where explainers would most likely live, sat behind a CAPTCHA wall during probing, so absence of evidence here is not proof of absence, which limits confidence.
